parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.064498) as it performed worse than our current best (1.043604). It seems increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.10 at DEPTH 6 with 5% warmup was less effective than the previous configuration. Returning to the DEPTH 6, LR 0.08 baseline. Next, I will experiment with increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to see if it improves model capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 at DEPTH 6 and LR 0.08 to improve representation capacity.
